articles.summary: Experts predict 2026 may become the hottest year on record due to El Nino, a recurring weather phase. El Nino is expected to dry out regions including India, potentially affecting agriculture and water resources. The phenomenon could exacerbate existing climate challenges in the country.

articles.title: New Aircraft Carrier Heads To Middle East Amid Reports Of USS Lincoln Issue
articles.summary: The USS George Washington, a US Navy aircraft carrier based in the Pacific, has been deployed to the Middle East amid reports of mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln. The move comes as part of ongoing US military operations in the region. This development may have implications for India's defence and foreign policy, given the strategic importance of the Middle East and US-India defence cooperation.

articles.title: FSSAI Slammed Over Delay In Warning Labels On Packaged Foods
articles.summary: The Supreme Court criticized the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) for delaying the implementation of Front-of-Pack Labeling (FOPL) on packaged foods. The bench, led by Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran, emphasized the need for these labels to raise awareness, particularly among children who are increasingly consuming junk food. The court's remarks came during a hearing on the matter.
articles.raw_summary: A bench comprising Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said FOPL labels are necessary to create awareness, especially among growing children who are becoming addicted to junk food.

articles.title: Akali Dal To Continue "Punjab Bachao" Rallies Despite Attack On Sukhbir Badal
articles.summary: Senior Akali Dal leader Daljit Singh Cheema announced that the party will proceed with its scheduled 'Punjab Bachao' rallies despite an attack on former Deputy Chief Minister Sukhbir Badal. The rallies are part of ongoing political activism by the Akali Dal. The decision highlights demands for policy action on issues affecting Punjab, potentially involving governance or civil liberties concerns.
articles.raw_summary: Senior Akali leader Daljit Singh Cheema said the rallies will be held as scheduled.

articles.title: Man Assaults, Shows Obscene Video To Woman Cab Driver In Gurugram, Arrested
articles.summary: A man was arrested in Gurugram for assaulting and showing an obscene video to a woman cab driver. The incident was registered at Police Station DLF Sector-29. Such crimes often prompt calls for stronger safety measures and legal reforms to protect women, particularly in the gig economy.
articles.raw_summary: According to police, a case was registered at Police Station DLF Sector-29.

articles.title: Amit Malviya's "Hiding Behind Algorithms" Charge Against Tech Platforms
articles.summary: Amit Malviya, a prominent political figure, criticized tech platforms for using algorithms as a defense mechanism when questioned about their operations. He argued that these platforms hide behind algorithmic processes to avoid accountability. The remarks underscore growing concerns in India about the regulation of digital platforms and their governance.

articles.title: ETtech Explainer: Why are dark stores again under scrutiny over food safety
articles.summary: Food safety inspectors in Karnataka and Maharashtra conducted inspections at quick commerce firms Zepto and Blinkit, uncovering violations in hygiene, storage, and labeling. The scrutiny follows the rapid expansion of dark stores by these companies to enable faster deliveries. The findings highlight compliance gaps under India's food safety regulations, prompting regulatory action. This could lead to stricter enforcement or policy measures for e-commerce food delivery platforms.
articles.raw_summary: Food safety inspectors have conducted thorough checks on quick commerce locations in Karnataka and Maharashtra, revealing violations related to hygiene, storage practices, and labeling standards at both Zepto and Blinkit. The latest actions follow in the wake of quick commerce firms expanding their dark store network to drive growth, improve customer reach, and enable faster deliveries.
